ns2:course.label: Jewelry/Metals I
ns2:course.description: Design and execution of jewelry and related objects through fabrication, focusing on surface embellishment, joining, and finishing processes; exploring metal as a medium of personal aesthetic expression. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Sophomore standing or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. Class Materials Fee of $95 required.
